item.title: Show HN: Femto: A fork of kilo (text editor)
item.summary: A fork of kilo, a small text editor in less than 1000 LOC with syntax highlighting and search, enhanced with fixes from community pull requests, issue discussions, and personal improvements. Features: - Advanced Syntax Highlighting - Configuration File (~/.femtorc) - Batch Find and Replace - Undo/Redo (up to 100 levels) - Search with next/previous navigation - Mouse support for cursor positioning - Alternate screen buffer support (can be disabled with --no-alt-screen) - Configurable tab size - Auto-indent - Line numbers - Current line highlighting Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49194998 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
